evidence.why: Renderer-supplied webPreferences are spread after the secure defaults (nodeIntegration:false, contextIsolation:true, sandbox:true), allowing the caller to override and re-enable nodeIntegration/disable isolation/sandbox.

This IPC handler passes attacker/renderer-controlled options (including windowOptions.webPreferences and arbitrary url) directly into createChildWindow with no validation, reaching the override at line 31.

controls_present: setWindowOpenHandler denies default window.open and routes through createChildWindow
secure defaults set for nodeIntegration/contextIsolation/sandbox in both main and child windows
preload exposes a small fixed set of named functions over contextBridge
other_classes_observed: No origin/URL validation before loadURL in createChildWindow, allowing navigation to arbitrary renderer-supplied URLs (CWE-601-ish open redirect/SSRF-like behavior)
IPC handler trusts caller-supplied windowOptions wholesale without schema validation
